turns: Police came to our house last night, they say an FIR for cheating has been filed against my brother by his business partner and they may arrest him. What section will they use and how do we get bail?

results.reply:
I’m not a lawyer, but here’s what you can do right now:
- Call the free legal‑aid helpline 15100 (NALSA) for immediate advice and help to get a lawyer.
- Ask the police for a copy of the FIR (it should list the exact section). Since the offence is after 1 July 2024, it will be under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), not the old IPC.
- Bail is usually applied for in the court that issued the FIR. You’ll need a lawyer to file a bail application and to attend the hearing.
- Keep any documents that prove your brother’s side (contracts, payment records, messages, bank statements).
- If you feel his safety is at risk, you can also call 112 for police protection.

Next step: Call NALSA (15100) right away to get a free lawyer who can look at the FIR and start the bail process.

citations.act: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 / Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
citations.title: New criminal laws in force from 1 July 2024
citations.plain: Since 1 July 2024, the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) has replaced the Indian Penal Code (IPC), and the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) has replaced the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC). For offences committed on or after that date, cite BNS and BNSS section numbers, not IPC or CrPC ones.

citations.title: NALSA legal aid helpline 15100
citations.plain: Call the national legal aid helpline 15100 (toll-free) for free legal advice and help applying for legal aid. You can also apply for legal aid or victim compensation online via the NALSA website.

citations.act: Emergency Response Support System (Ministry of Home Affairs)
citations.title: Single national emergency number 112
citations.plain: 112 is India's single emergency number for police, fire, ambulance and women's helplines, run under the Ministry of Home Affairs' Emergency Response Support System (ERSS).
